entries.title: Incompatible AWS provider constraints
entries.root_cause: The root configuration requires AWS provider version 5.42.0 or newer while the fenway module constrains it below 5.40.0, leaving no matching version. Align the module and root provider constraints.

entries.title: Required Terraform input is missing
entries.root_cause: The required lockbox_region input has no value in the plan job. Supply that input to the Terraform invocation.

entries.title: Terraform configuration directory is absent
entries.root_cause: The workflow changes into an obsolete configuration directory that does not exist after the directory was renamed. Update the working directory in the workflow.
